title: APPEAL/2/2025 — V S BHANDARI COLD HOUSE vs. CANARA BANK
text:
Court of Registrar
DEBTS RECOVERY TRIBUNAL, JAIPUR
APPEAL
M/S V.S. BHANDARI COLDHOUSE LTD.
V/S
CANARA BANK LTD
ITEM NO.19
Diary No- 201/2025
Dated:- 04-02-2025
Shri Akarsah Mathur, counsel for the applicant is present.
I have perused the office report. As per office report application
barred by limitation but applicant has filed an application under
section 5 of limitation act. Now APPEAL be registered subject to
preserved right of respondent on limitation point.
The matter be listed before the Hon’ble Presiding Officer 0n
06.02.2024 for arguments on application of u/s 5 of limitation act.
Registrar
11
